The KGB will now serve as a sword and shield for the Presidium, shielding us from danger and striking down our enemies before they get the chance to.
strings.IRK_empowered_red_army_desc: The NKVD has held a prominent role in military affairs for too long and the Presidium has taken steps to reverse course. Now, our skilled and courageous generals can conduct military operations without constantly looking over their shoulders for fear of offending the NKVD.
strings.IRK_administrative_shortcomings_desc: Our near-collapse in the Buryatian Mutiny is proof that something must be done about our administrative issues. Every day, there are reports of corruption within regional administrations, questionable decisions being made, and taxes being lost. There is no time to waste - something must be done, and quickly.
strings.IRK_administrative_shortcomings_2_desc: Our near-collapse in the Buryatian Mutiny, combined with the recent overturning of our administration, is proof that something must be done about our administrative issues. Every day, there are reports of corruption within regional administrations, of asinine decisionmaking, and of funds being lost (or worse). There is no time to waste - something must be done, and quickly.
strings.IRK_remember_the_revolution_desc: Sablin has attempted to claim the mantle of Lenin's revolution, painting himself as a true Leninist and his band of scum as spiritual successors to the October Revolution. While this is obviously nonsense, many of our citizens have fallen under the sway of these lies. We must prove that we carry the torch of the workers' revolution, while the partisans are nothing more than deceitful reactionaries. For this purpose, a propaganda campaign appropriating his messaging will do the trick.
strings.IRK_the_union_forever_desc: Let reactionaries fight, and militants sabotage us; let wreckers and tools of foreign imperialisms nip at our heels - we care not! We will fight, even until death, to preserve the Union! The Soviet Union shall endure forever!
strings.IRK_yagodite_atrocities_desc:
The Red Terror of the Russian Revolution was a violent, but necessary measure as the monarchists and Whites resisted the people. It demonstrated the willingness of the revolutionaries to not merely punish tyranny - but actively purge it. This reassurance is again needed, so the people rest easy knowing the greatest threats to Russia are being dealt with - and to break the spirits of our enemies.

Let them know there will be no reprieve; no mercy for those who stand against the Soviet Union.
strings.IRK_enhanced_intelligence_desc: Recent measures by our government have strengthened our intelligence efforts, with a particular benefit seen in decryption. This is certain to yield constructive results as we rebuild the Union and make it truly ironclad.
strings.IRK_ironclad_union_desc: In 1921, the 10th Party Congress recognized the danger of party factionalism to the Soviet Union when they passed the Resolution on Party Unity. We must affirm their decision and clamp down on any organized dissent within the Communist Party. While the Presidium deals with external enemies, we must not give our internal enemies the chance to undermine the Union.
strings.IRK_labor_battalions_desc: In exchange for reduced sentences, we have recruited gulag prisoners to assist our military engineers during our battle against Sablin.
strings.IRK_bureaucracy_purged_desc: By decree of the government, we recently purged large swathes of our bureaucracy of reactionaries, wreckers, and foreign subversives. Though what remains is far more loyal, it is also far less capable of governing the lands ruled by the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet, and as a result our governance is suffering greatly.
strings.IRK_ministry_reorganizations_desc: As a result of a decree of the General Secretary, the ministries in the Irkutsk Government have recently been reorganised.
strings.IRK_bureaucracy_purged_2_desc: By decree of the government, we recently purged large swathes of our bureaucracy; however, it was deemed opportune with regard to the interests of the Revolution to permit the smallest offenders chances to prove themselves again. The necessary damage done by this action has been reduced by a combination of the above and the entrance of new, loyal officials into our government.
strings.IRK_bureaucracy_purged_forgiven_desc: By decree of the government, we recently purged large swathes of our bureaucracy; however, it was deemed opportune with regard to the interests of the Revolution to permit the smallest offenders chances to prove themselves again. However, the damage done to our government, though necessary, has not truly been repaired by this magnanimity.
strings.IRK_a_union_of_letters_desc: Named after the 17th century “republic of letters”, we are aiming to foster a similar culture of innovation. Open criticism in all levels of government is to be encouraged, so long as it is constructive. Workers and bureaucrats alike will be asked to mail in their thoughts and concerns regarding our reunification struggle. Our expectation is that this will redound solely to our benefit.
strings.IRK_streamlined_supply_chain_desc: As a result of recent efforts we have successfully streamlined our supply chain. This will enable us to fight better and more efficiently against the various enemies of the All-Russian Communist Party.
strings.IRK_additional_army_commissars_desc: Army commissars have been appointed in order to promote proper socialist discipline in warfare and military operations more generally. Though some reactionaries and wreckers may complain, we are fully assured that this will ensure total victory.
strings.IRK_operation_ariel_desc: The territory of Chita, as with the whole of the Far East, is rightfully Soviet land; however, due to our temporary weakness an Australian squatter claiming Romanov blood and backed by some of the Harbin splinters has seized control over it. This shall not be tolerated - let us continue what Ilyich started, and remove yet more Romanovs from our lands!
strings.IRK_operation_umbriel_desc: As if monarchists, pirates, and ethnic separatists were not enough actual Hitler-lovers had to take root in our lands. This should not be tolerated. Rodzaevsky and his band of fascists will be extirpated, root and branch, and the nation cleansed!
strings.IRK_operation_miranda_desc: The opportunist Matkovsky, occupier of the all-important port of Magadan, claims to be more 'pragmatic' than his Hitlerite and monarchst brothers. Such things matter not; we see only a reactionary squatting upon Soviet land, and we will wipe him out!
strings.IRK_operation_neptune_desc: The diamonds of Yakutia must not be hoarded by close-minded regionalists or reactionary fascists. Yakutia's wealth belongs to the people and on the people's behalf, we shall seize this wealth.
strings.IRK_operation_pluto_desc: Reactionary religious fascists led by a priest more skilled than many of his evil kindred in disseminating what Marx rightly called the 'opiate of the masses' have occupied the once-anarchic Omolon region in the aftermath of the Buryat Mutiny. Now that we are stronger, we will move at once to cleanse the Socialist Far East of this plague!
strings.IRK_expanded_the_gulag_desc: We have expanded the GULAG work camp system to deal with the recent rise in prisoners.
strings.IRK_cold_weather_training_desc: All Russians are acclimatized to the harsh winters of their Motherland, but ours do more than just survive - they thrive, and will ensure that the enemy cannot.
strings.IRK_frontline_commissars_desc: The soldiers are not always as obedient as they should be; at times they harbour thoughts of dissent or of reaction. No better panacea exists for this than the existence and promotion of the old military commissar system. At a small cost of command effectiveness and war enthusiasm, we will strengthen our political efforts and make the soldiers take not even one step back.
strings.IRK_strengthened_ministries_desc: The men of the Presidium are the vanguard of the proletariat. The responsibility for advancing socialism, and the interests of the workers' dictatorship, should lie primarily with them. They know what is best for the people.
strings.IRK_not_one_step_back_desc: Bukharin hesitated to enforce uncompromising revolutionary discipline upon the Red Army, but we shall not. Retreat before the foe is tantamount to treason, and will be punished appropriately.
strings.IRK_the_union_triumphant_desc: Today is a glorious day for the people of the Far East in Russia, as we have fully liberated the region and its inhabitants from their shackles. The power of the people has been shown to be triumphant over all others, and the Union stands, with its red banner flying high above all others!
strings.IRK_a_peoples_union_desc: The revisionist elements supporting Yagoda have been disposed of through a joint effort between the Presidium and Red Army. With these rotten branches cleaned away, the healthy regrowth of the Union can resume, and this time yield true fruit for the people.
strings.IRK_a_secure_union_desc: The mutinous elements within the Presidium and Red Army have been disposed of, and their foolish ideas with them. With the rotten branches cleared away, the healthy regrowth of our Union can resume.
strings.IRK_paris_of_siberia_desc: Irkutsk is more than a simple city; it is the indomitable will and ingenuity of the Russian proletariat made manifest. No others could have built such a grand and beautiful expression of civilisation in the heart of Siberia.
strings.IRK_mutiny_nkvd_guards_detachments_tt: A division of elite NKVD Guards will be trained in the capital.
strings.IRK_increase_party_influence_low_tt: Increases Party influence by a small amount.
strings.IRK_increase_party_influence_high_tt: Increases Party influence by a large amount.
strings.IRK_increase_nkvd_influence_low_tt: Increases State influence by a small amount.
strings.IRK_increase_nkvd_influence_high_tt: Increases State influence by a large amount.
strings.IRK_appease_party_faction_tt: The State faction has secured sufficient influence (50).
strings.IRK_appease_state_faction_tt: The Party faction has secured sufficient influence (50).
strings.IRK_party_influence_locked_in: The power of the Party faction has been secured.
strings.IRK_state_influence_locked_in: The power of the State faction has been secured.
strings.IRK_elect_new_premier_desc: A new Premier of the Soviet Union aligned more closely with the Party faction will be elected. The power of the Party faction shall be assured.
strings.IRK_elect_new_premier_tt: The Party faction has secured sufficient influence (75).
strings.IRK_strengthen_the_red_army_desc: The jurisdiction of the Red Army over matters pertaining to national security will be increased, eroding NKVD influence over domestic military affairs.
strings.IRK_strengthen_the_red_army_tt: The Party faction has secured sufficient influence (55).
strings.IRK_establish_the_kgb_desc: A new intelligence agency with jurisdiction over foreign intelligence will be established, eroding NKVD influence over foreign affairs.
strings.IRK_establish_the_kgb_tt: The Party faction has secured sufficient influence (60).
strings.IRK_weaken_ministry_powers_desc: Various appointments will be made throughout the People's Commissariats of the USSR, and new industrial regulations will be enacted to allow for closer supervision and higher labor standards.
strings.IRK_weaken_ministry_powers_tt: The Party faction has secured sufficient influence (50).
strings.IRK_relax_media_censorship_desc: To foster a stronger and richer proletarian culture, censorship and repression of media shall be relaxed, and new boards set up to approve literary works for publishing.
strings.IRK_relax_media_censorship_tt: The Party faction has secured sufficient influence (55).
strings.IRK_strengthen_general_secretary_powers_: The powers of the General Secretary of the Communist Party will be greatly expanded. The power of the State faction shall be assured.
The State faction has secured sufficient influence (75).
strings.IRK_expand_nkvd_jurisdiction_desc: The jurisdiction that the NKVD possesses shall be increased to grant their units unrestricted freedom to act in frontline operations. A new NKVD Rifle Division will be raised in the capital.
strings.IRK_expand_nkvd_jurisdiction_tt: The State faction has secured sufficient influence (65).
strings.IRK_strengthen_ministry_powers_desc: The autonomy of the People's Commissariats of the USSR shall be increased, and functionaries shall benefit from less direct oversight from Party political organs.
strings.IRK_strengthen_ministry_powers_tt: The State faction has secured sufficient influence (60).
strings.IRK_appoint_army_commissars_desc: New political commissars shall be appointed to high-level positions within the Red Army, to ensure the political reliability of its officers. Unreliable officers will be subject to expulsion from the Communist Party, or removal from their posts.
strings.IRK_appoint_army_commissars_tt: The State faction has secured sufficient influence (50).
strings.IRK_expand_rehabiliatory_labor_system_de: The authority of the GULAG agency shall be expanded, and greater allowances shall be made for the use of forced labor in state industry.
strings.IRK_expand_rehabiliatory_labor_system_tt: The State faction has secured sufficient influence (55).
strings.IRK_reform_timer_tt: We have not passed a reform in the last 180 days. Current days are: [?IRK_reformed_flag:days|Y0]
strings.IRK_regional_industrial_centric_developm: At the cost of $120 million USD, we will build new factories for the Union.
strings.IRK_regional_partition_of_the_coast_tt: This will increase our GDP by $100 USD.
strings.IRK_regional_invest_in_transportation_tt: At the cost of $150 million USD, we will improve our infrastructure.
strings.IRK_regional_import_industrial_machinery: At the cost of $40 million USD, we will import new industrial equipment.
strings.IRK_regional_the_shipyards_of_amur_tt: At the cost of $60 million USD, we will build new dockyards.
strings.IRK_regional_develop_the_aerospace_indus: At the cost of $120 million USD, we will build new factories.

strings.IRK_five_year_plans_desc:
Thanks to the successful efforts by the NKVD to reassert Soviet control over the parts of Siberia that were lost in the collapse, the Port of Magadan has been liberated. With the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet once more in control of the only functional port in Russia that isn't blockaded by the enemy, it shall henceforth be our window to the outside world and a key strategic component in our efforts to reclaim every last inch of the Soviet Union that's temporarily been lost to anarchy, fascism and revisionists.

Guiding our efforts to achieve our new economic goals is the Soviet Development and Reform Commission. Established after our move to Irkutsk, it's staffed by the brightest economists in our Union. They remain sharply divided, however, with those more closely aligned with Chairman Genrikh Yagoda arguing for a transition into a dual economic system that preserves the basic spirit of communism. Those aligned with the Party Faction nominally led by Sergey Bessonov advocate for a more orthodox approach employed by our economic planners in the past. Whichever path we choose, however, we must make sure that we preserve the basic spirit of communism as we restore Soviet order across our lands.

strings.IRK_begin_the_eigth_five_year_plan_desc: With the initial underperformance of the last Five Year Plan remedied thanks to the reclamation of more parts of the Soviet Union and the restoration of its resources to rightful Soviet rule, S.D.R.C. has revised their projections for the Eighth plan. With its successful completion according to our economists projections, the Soviet Union's economic strength will surpass what we had before the outbreak of the Siberian War!
strings.IRK_encourage_international_volunteers_d: In the past, the Soviet Union organized international forces in collaboration with local communist parties, fostering a spirit of solidarity in our collective struggle. A lot has changed since the thirties and now it's the Soviet Union itself that needs help. As the rightful seat of the Soviet government, we'll reach out to the remaining socialist movements of the world to organize volunteer forces to be sent to us through the port of Magadan. While this will help us with our regrettable manpower situation, these men and women are not of the highest quality, even under NKVD supervision.
strings.IRK_repair_the_baikal_highway_desc: The M55 Highway connecting the temporary Soviet capital to the rest of Siberia has been badly damaged as a result of the recent uprising by the revisionist agitators under Sablin. As we've already dealt with their punishments for this insurrection, we'll use this as an opportunity to rehabilitate some of his former men by assigning them to a state construction firm. They should be thankful that we're giving them a path back to socialist labor - the other rebels will not be as lucky...
strings.IRK_finish_the_amur_highway_desc: One of the issues noted by our economists is the lack of functional trains and reliable roads as a result of the persistent efforts of the enemies of the people to disrupt Soviet rule in Siberia. While those leading out of the temporary Soviet capital are serviceable, the same can't be said about the recently reclaimed areas to the east. It's therefore of the utmost importance that we restore the roads to working condition so that we may continue with our economic development. Started in the past decades as part of the Siberian Plan, the M58 connecting Chita to Amur was left unfinished due to the Great Patriotic War and the subsequent disruptions in communications. Organizing a supplemental labor battalion out of the RFP prisoners from the liberation of Amur should ensure the swift completion of the project. Justice will be dispensed as their masters in Berlin caused this unfortunate delay in the first place.
strings.IRK_complete_the_magadan_connection_desc: The M56 was an endeavor to connect Magadan to the more temperate parts of Siberia. Many laborers risked life and limb to achieve this monument to socialist progress, but just like they've destroyed so many things in the Soviet Union, the fascists that occupied the port of Magadan have let most of the oblast's infrastructure go to waste. Justice shall be swift, and the NKVD will make sure that a labour detail consisting of Matkovsky's captured men repair every last inch of the road that they wrecked. Once we have a decent road leading into Magadan, we can finally begin transporting goods to and from the port.
strings.IRK_restoration_of_irkutsk_hps_desc: During the brief period during which the Soviet Union was limited to merely holding on to the area of Irkutsk, S.D.R.C. made the assessment that our temporary shortage of necessary equipment made it impossible to fully maintain the Irkutsk HPS. As a result, the power station visibly bears the scars of half a decade's worth of maintenance cuts and hasn't been operating at an ideal capacity for years. With the liberation of the Soviet Far East and its resources however we can finally resume the scheduled work and tie it into our plans to expand the plant in the future. Merely catching up on the maintenance work, however, would be more than enough to put us in a position where we can keep our industries going without needing to ration electricity.
strings.IRK_revive_amurs_agricultural_sector_des: Previously under control of the vile fascists of the RFP, the fields of Amur have gone from being some of the most productive in Siberia to being a desolate wasteland due to the uprooting of the Soviet central planning of the region's farmlands. Ministry of Agriculture and Food have estimated the manpower needed to revitalize the yields and bring them back to pre-Siberian War levels and have suggested that we'll use the current state of hard-fought stability and peace to rotate some of our conscripted peasants back into their old work and draw on some of the recently liberated population belonging to less vital economic sectors to even out our numbers. While agriculture by itself is no longer a key factor in a modern industrialized economy as was the case during the birth of our Union, we cannot hope to fully transition into one when a good portion of our population can barely scrape by.
strings.IRK_expand_the_port_of_magadan_desc: Magadan's importance to our economy cannot be understated. In order to open ourselves up to the global economy, we must first improve the harbor to increase its capacity for both imports and exports as well as expand our icebreaker fleet to the point where we can reliably keep the port open all year round. Once it's completed, we can embark on the next step of our Five Year Plan.
strings.IRK_rapid_factory_modernization_desc: With our improved access to the outside world comes the obvious benefits of having easier access to industrial equipment. While our landlocked rivals in the west struggle to get their hands on modern machinery as they're surrounded by uncooperative rogue states, our access to the sea changes the situation entirely. With the recent expansion of Magadan's facilities, we're in a good position to import the kind of machinery we need to revitalize our industrial economy.
strings.IRK_revive_the_mining_industry_desc: Beneath the surface of Siberia lies vast, untapped riches. Coal, gold, diamonds, iron ore, and a myriad of valuable minerals are right at our fingertips, but sadly cannot currently be excavated due to many of our mines falling into disrepair during the anarchy. By importing equipment and schematics from abroad, we can undo years of decay in short order.
strings.IRK_trade_with_the_developing_world_desc: While our economy was never officially closed, it has understandably been struggling due to the anarchy putting development into a state of abject stasis. Despite the many disagreements that Yagoda and the Party factions have, this is one area where they see common ground as trade with friendly and neutral states in Asia and across the Pacific can work in harmony both with the old Bukharinite system and the coexistence between Marxism and capitalism envisioned by some of our newer economists. With products to offer the world and a profound need for goods to bolster our economy, we'll initiate efforts to restore trade ties with former partners in the developing world and seek out new trade ties as well.
strings.IRK_modernizing_the_irkutsk_hps_desc: The turbines used in the Irkutsk HPS linger back to the days of the Siberian Plan. While not a direct target in any of the recent wars, the aftershocks caused by the fall of Moscow and the Siberian War can still be felt to this day. By purchasing equipment on the foreign markets and hiring experts to help us modernize the plants to the standards of this decade, the provisory capital of the Soviet Union will be ranked among the most important electricity production stations in all of Asia. Needless to say, this will go a long way to achieve the goals of our Five Year Plan by ensuring plentiful of electricity day and night, all year around for both common citizens, state industries and investors alike.
strings.IRK_the_economic_heart_of_siberia_desc: Our renovation and revitalization of the current seat of Soviet power must not be a half-measure. As the most advanced city in the Soviet Union, Irkutsk will take the first steps into being a modern economy. Avoiding reckless marches into the unknown, we'll limit the Union's evolution into a more contemporary economic model to take the shape of gradual steps, starting out by tweaking the legal framework for businesses in the city as well as investing in the creation of state service companies. Whereas we relied on raw industrial strength in the past, the economy of the new Union will be known for its efficiency as well.
strings.IRK_the_open_coastal_city_of_magadan: The Open Coastal City of Magadan
strings.IRK_the_open_coastal_city_of_magadan_des: As we advance towards realizing the Yagodaschina, it's time that we put theory into practice. Magadan will be the first cite where we will initiate a full-scale experiment in our new economic theory of two systems co-existing in the Soviet Union, reaping the rewards of a more modern economy while preserving the Marxist ideals our revolution was founded on.
strings.IRK_the_industrial_harbor_of_magadan_des: With those seeking to betray the revolution and compromise with capitalism having lost the economic debate, it's time for us to move towards reaching the goals of our Five Year Plan- Through a heavy industrialization scheme that builds upon the successes of the Siberian Plan while also learning from its mistakes, we'll bring more prosperity to our Union.
strings.IRK_the_second_industrialization_wave_de: In order to achieve our industrial goals, a second wave of investments into the state's heavy industry sector is needed. It'll be a broad push for industrial growth across the Union, seeing the construction and local modernizations of several factory complexes in all our major cities.
strings.IRK_expand_brigade_recruitment_desc: With war on the horizon, we might want to look into expanding our volunteer recruitment and lower the standards for the volunteers that we do accept as well as providing volunteers with easier travel to the Union. While the influx of spirited men and women of strong socialist convictions is undoubtedly going to strengthen us, it will put a further strain on our efforts to train our army.
strings.IRK_special_economic_sector_desc: After taking the first step towards modernizing our temporary capital's economy, it's time to take the next one. Avoiding the mistake of taking a great leap forward, we'll limit the reform package to opening up parts of Irkutsk's central areas to foreign investments and provide generous legal and tax incentives to attract foreign capital with the state driving the push towards a service-based economic model for the city.
strings.IRK_yakutia_special_economic_province_de: Back during the early days of the NEP's implementation it wasn't unheard of for British and Japanese mining companies to invest in the Soviet Union. Yagoda believes that with the right tax incentives, Yakutia could become a hotbed for foreign mining companies seeking to establish themselves on Soviet soil. Naturally, we'll make sure that our most important strategic resources remain firmly under the control of the State.
strings.IRK_chita_special_economic_sector_desc: Despite our many disagreements with the CPS in the past, recent developments have necessitated economic pragmatism towards the Sphere. Opening up Chita as a SES would thus be an ideal move, allowing us to expand our economy while also signaling our intentions to improve our ties with Japan. By allowing Japanese Zaibatsu to establish themselves in the city, we can turn it into one of Asia's great industrial hubs.
strings.IRK_petropavlovsk_kamchatsky_open_coasta: With our efforts to approach the OFN bearing fruit, the Chairman believes that we need to strike while the iron is hot. As our closest territory to America, we'll declare Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky as an additional OCC and use state incentives to create an investment climate that's attractive to American technology companies. Naturally, we will arrange matters so that we can benefit from their expertise as well...
strings.IRK_the_ninth_five_year_plan_state_desc: Chairman Yagoda's Eighth Five Year Plan has been a resounding success. The success of the Yagodaschina cannot be denied by anyone, for it was this measured approach to economics that not only saw our Union prosper again, but also allowed us to reclaim another portion of our Soviet Motherland from its illegitimate occupants. Now the time has come to launch an even more ambitious Five Year Plan - one that shall see us restore Soviet control throughout the Russian anarchy and beyond.
strings.IRK_third_industrialization_wave_desc: With our course set, we need to expand the industrialization plan beyond the great cities and allow the smaller cities to reap the rewards of Soviet industry. When we're done, every hamlet in the Far East will become a testament to the success of our laborers!
strings.IRK_coal_mining_boom_desc: While those in the party that sought to undermine proper Marxist applications of economic theory speak of investments by foreign companies in the Soviet Union, we know that our strategic resources are too important to allow the forces of capital gain too strong a hold. That being said, as long as they're just merely under the ground it's hardly of any use to us. We'll expand our excavations of the South Yakutsk basins to bring more coal to fuel our industrial growth.
strings.IRK_increase_production_quotas_desc: In order to achieve the goals set by our economists, it's become blatantly clear to us that we need to raise the production quotas in all state-owned factories. While unpopular, steps like this will be needed if we wish to avoid repeating the disastrous mistakes of the last administration.
strings.IRK_increase_industrial_trade_desc: With our recent industrial expansions it's clear that we've made ourselves more competitive in the developing markets. By seeking to expand our trade deals with neutral states as well as the few handful of socialist states that still exist, we should be able to give a healthy infusion of cash into our state budget on a regular basis.
strings.IRK_the_ninth_five_year_plan_party_desc: The Eighth Five Year Plan has been a resounding success. Not only have we bested the internal opposition and charted our own path towards improving the lives of our Soviet citizens, but we've also managed the difficult feat of liberating another piece of the old Union as a direct result of our diligent work. There's no time to rest though as the party has already approved the framework for a Ninth Five Year Plan, one that will allow us to modernize our recently liberated Siberian territories to the west of our temporary capital. Forward!
strings.IRK_the_great_siberian_highway_project_d: The M53 was a planned highway project meant to link Irkutsk with Novosibirsk. Fallen on the wayside due to the outbreak of the Great Patriotic War and with its finished sections tarnished by the neglect of the many petty warlords that occupied the areas of land where stretches of this road still existed, it's truly in a sorry state. Our economists believe that with the right investments, we could turn the old vision into reality and link every major city of Central Siberia to our capital. A massive boon to our economy at times of peace, and an equally great benefit to our logistics should our friends in the west not surrender the rightful Soviet territories they occupy without a fight.
strings.IRK_novosibirsk_special_economic_sector_: Novosibirsk is an ideal city to establish another SES. Its great industrial and technological capacities combined with its excellent airport makes it a perfect site for commercial and industrial investment. By opening it up to outside investors under a carefully controlled and planned framework, we'll be able to greatly enrich our Union while also reaping the benefits of the technologies that the foreign companies bring to the table when they establish themselves in the SES.
strings.IRK_kemerovos_palaces_of_industry_desc: The mighty factories of Kemerovo are a testament to Soviet economic prowess, one that managed to survive several bloody wars and still go from strength to stunning strength. With this great city back under rightful Soviet control, we'll make it the lynchpin for our industrialization efforts in the region.
strings.IRK_western_companies_in_tomsk_desc: A great opportunity has arisen. Thanks to our improving ties with the OFN nations and the great scientific expertise that resided in the city of Tomsk, there's now talk of western medical companies seeking to establish themselves in the Soviet Union. If we accept, we can expect to be able to advance our own medical research sector as well.
strings.IRK_zaibatsu_in_krasnoyarsk_desc: Datsun, Toyota and other major Japanese car manufacturers have voiced interest in setting up factories in the industrial city of Krasnoyarsk.If we manage this situation correctly and apply the right kinds of protectionist measures on the national level while reaping the financial benefits on a local one, this could be a great boost to the Soviet automobile industry.
